body:
# Demo Lib Evolution Constitution

Rules the loop can never change. Demo Lib ships the product.

## Hard stops

Identical to the hard stops in `AGENTS.md`. The loop never crosses them and never proposes a change to them.

- destructive or irreversible actions, production, deploy, publish, merge
- credentials, hosted-data deletion, broad auth, billing, or data migration

## Immutable paths

| Path | Why |
| --- | --- |
| <product hard-stop surfaces only> | Tier 2 surfaces (ADR-NNN) |

## Editable scope by stage

| Stage | Paths |
| --- | --- |
| Product | <product paths, e.g. `src/`> |

## Vote rules

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Suggestion expiry with no votes | <N> days |
| Not amendable by vote | Hard stops, Kill switch, Amendments, frontmatter |

## Amendments

A human edits this record.

## Kill switch

`loop: off` in this frontmatter halts every cycle.
